benchmarks.source: Glaser et al. 2014, Icarus 243, 78-90 (LOLA 20 m/pixel DTM, 19-year study)
benchmarks.sourceLocator: Connecting Ridge results: 92.27% at 2 m, 95.65% at 10 m; longest continuous darkness typically 3-5 days
benchmarks.modelSimplification: Cross-check only: the 117 h default longest shadow sits inside the 3-5 day range, while the 0.71 default fraction is deliberately more conservative than the best site

benchmarks.quantity: polar water-extractor mass and heater power for the NASA baseline case
benchmarks.source: Kleinhenz & Paz 2020, Case Studies for Lunar ISRU Systems Utilizing Polar Water, AIAA 2020-4042
benchmarks.sourceLocator: Table 3 (15 t water in 225 days, 5 wt%, 75% extraction efficiency); Fig. 8 water-extractor mass (~330 kg, read from log scale, incl. 20% growth + 15% structure margins); Sec. IV.B water extractor ~20 kW incl. 20% power margin, i.e. ~16.7 kW
benchmarks.modelSimplification: Calibration anchor, not independent validation: the kIceExtractorMass and etaSubHeater defaults were derived from this case, so agreement confirms the derivation. Linear scaling with regolith throughput is conservative at larger plants (the study's Fig. 9A is sub-linear).

benchmarks.quantity: electrolysis power, LOX/LH2 liquefaction power, and liquefier and electrolyzer mass for the NASA baseline propellant case
benchmarks.source: Kleinhenz & Paz 2020, Case Studies for Lunar ISRU Systems Utilizing Polar Water, AIAA 2020-4042
benchmarks.sourceLocator: Table 3 (15 t water to 13 t O2 + 1.7 t H2 over 225 days less 48 h commissioning, i.e. 67.26 kg/day water); Fig. 8 subsystem mass and ridge power, measured on the log axes and checked against the stated totals (ridge 2.6 t and 46 kW, mine 0.49 t and 22 kW, tankers 1.8 t). Electrolyzer 21.0 kW, H2 liquefaction 20.3 kW, and O2 liquefaction 3.94 kW include a 20% power margin, removed here; masses (electrolyzer 47 + dryers 51 kg, H2 liquefaction 1,753 kg, O2 liquefaction 150 kg) include the study's growth and structure margins.
benchmarks.modelSimplification: Calibration anchor, not independent validation: secCondLh2, secCondLox, kLiquefierLh2, kLiquefierLox, and kElectrolyzerMass were derived from this case, so their agreement confirms the derivation. Electrolysis power is the independent check (cell voltage 1.8 V at 95% Faradaic efficiency) and runs about 10% low; the study's figure includes pumps and balance of plant. Linear scaling with product rate is conservative for larger plants, most of all for H2 liquefaction.
